name: How can I get rid of a moldy smell from my air vents?

mainEntity.name: How can I get rid of a moldy smell from my air vents?

acceptedAnswer.text: To eliminate a moldy smell, you must identify and remove the mold source and address the moisture problem. Start by inspecting visible vents and accessible ductwork. Cleaning minor surface mold might be possible, but extensive or hidden mold growth often requires professional remediation. A professional can identify the cause of moisture, thoroughly clean affected areas, and apply treatments to prevent future growth, ensuring proper air quality.
acceptedAnswer.description: To remove a moldy smell, you need to find and eliminate the mold source and fix any moisture issues. Extensive mold usually requires professional remediation.
